name: A Sucker Punch button is saved as Assault (#5469)
contract: With Dirty Fighter 806978, the Playing Dirty! buff 681787 runs aura_ascension_playing_dirty::Apply (AscensionRangerDirtyFighter.cpp:40), which learns Sucker Punch 681235 as a temporary spell (learnSpell(SPELL_SUCKER_PUNCH, true), line 46) and replaces every known Assault rank (chain 803108) with it through SetTemporarySpellReplacement (line 49). A temporary spell is never written to character_spell, and Player::_LoadActions runs before the buff is earned again, so a saved Sucker Punch button would be refused and deleted at login. persisted_action_button reads Player::GetSavedActionButtonSpell, the spell id _SaveActions writes: a button holding Sucker Punch must be saved as Assault 803108, and a button holding Assault itself is saved unchanged.

steps.label: Playing Dirty! replaces Assault with Sucker Punch
The Sucker Punch button is saved as Assault
Control: an ordinary known spell is saved unchanged
